source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
List the specific pollutants emitted in excess.
3. Note the times and dates when the excessive emissions occurred.
4. Record the concentration levels of the pollutants.
5. Include the duration of the excessive emissions.
6. Identify the source of the emissions.
7. Describe the industrial processes involved in the release.
8. Compare the observed emissions with legal standards and permit conditions.
9. Provide meteorological data for contextual understanding.
10. Include pictures or video footage, if available.
11. Mention the impact on local air quality and health.
12. Describe any mitigation efforts or corrective actions taken.
13. Prepare a narrative summary of the findings.
14. Provide recommendations for reducing future emissions.
15. Attach a map of the affected area.
16. Include contact information for responsible entities.
17. Verify data accuracy and validity.
18. Proofread the report for clarity and precision.

Example of a section from the report:

"**Excessive Emission Event:**
